actual_method: Option 1: code-first reuse and explicit unknowns, supplemented by bounded root qualitative diagnosis. This is not Option 2 with qualified midrange-model semantic inference per record.
unfulfilled_option2_component: No qualified batch model is assigning experience-object binding, requirement strength, alternative relationships or responsibility referents across the corpus. Engineering agents and limited case adjudication do not fulfill that component.
method_correction: The no-paid-API constraint led execution to rule-only summaries. Earlier descriptions implying continued full Option 2 execution were inaccurate; the narrower deliverable must be named explicitly.
decision: One bounded closeout followed by a frozen descriptive research release; no open-ended measurement iteration
fixed_scope: Existing old-corpus base and accepted D67 69-shard, 5804936-ad overlap; no further corpus expansion

parallel_tasks.task: Reuse existing diagnostic cases and traceable evidence for at most 24 examples
focus: Prior occupation/task experience versus current duties
Entry wording and current duties versus prior experience or other employees
parallel_tasks.rule: Reuse existing material first. At most one scheduled bounded context retrieval if necessary. Diagnostic cases are not an accuracy-estimation sample. No bulk model labeling

parallel_tasks.task: Complete literal years, requirement strength and qualification-condition summaries from existing evidence
parallel_tasks.rule: One bounded scheduled summarization using frozen technology groups and occupation support; preserve clause/ad denominators, multiple conditions, unknowns and unmeasured fields. No parser or dictionary redevelopment

parallel_tasks.task: One consolidated adjudication and final interpretation
parallel_tasks.rule: Permit at most one localized correction for a demonstrated core error; then freeze. Unresolved constructs remain exploratory or excluded rather than triggering another development round

parallel_tasks.task: Publish code, public tables, provenance and final claim-status register to Git
parallel_tasks.rule: No private texts, keys or row-level research data in Git

acceptance: Existing D67 engineering and numerical acceptance retained
Each reported measure linked to existing evidence/version and explicit denominator
Unknown and unmeasured values retained, not converted to negative labels
Two comparisons delivered with stable, measurement-sensitive and unresolved claims distinguished
Any localized correction passes only directly affected necessary checks
stop_rules: Do not require every ad to have a definite semantic label
Do not repeat reviews or expand dictionaries to increase detection
Do not add a new sample, model deployment, API or full-corpus run
Do not turn a targeted AI diagnostic into a semantic-accuracy claim
If existing evidence cannot support a variable, mark it unavailable and close that item
Additional research sensitivity work is a later analysis phase, not a reason to reopen this cleaning release
completion_definition: A frozen, usable descriptive measurement and comparison release; not proof of historical AI effects or universal semantic correctness
